description: Social selling and DM funnels — consent-first selling in the DMs, never spam. Use when someone wants to "sell in the DMs," "set up a comment-to-DM funnel," "do DM outreach," "turn comments/followers into leads or customers," or convert intent into private conversations. Works ONLY as a response to intent (comments, story replies, follows, keyword DMs) via the comment->DM->email funnel — never cold outreach. Uses the WARMS framework. Reads brand-profile + voice-builder + goals-and-kpis first. WoopSocial has NO DM/comment surface: the agent designs the funnel and drafts the trigger post, DM sequences, and manual outreach scripts; WoopSocial publishes the trigger posts; the actual comment->DM automation runs in an external official-Meta-API tool (ManyChat/LinkDM/etc.) or a human sends warm DMs; consent-first always, ban-behaviors avoided, metrics never fabricated. Distinct from link-in-bio-and-traffic, reply-and-comment-writer, and email-and-newsletter.
